37: lemma Typing.preservation (der : Typing Γ t τ) (step : t ⭢βᵛ t') : Typing Γ t' τ := by
38:   induction der generalizing t'
39:   case app Γ _ σ τ _ _ _ _ _ =>
40:     cases step
41:     case appₗ | appᵣ => grind
42:     case abs der _ _ =>
43:       have sub : Sub Γ (σ.arrow τ) (σ.arrow τ) := by grind [Sub.refl]
44:       have ⟨_, _, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ := der.abs_inv sub
45:       grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [fvTm] Var, openTm_substTm_intro, subst_tm, Sub.weaken]
46:   case tapp Γ _ σ τ σ' _ _ _ =>
47:     cases step
48:     case tabs der _ _ =>
49:       have sub : Sub Γ (σ.all τ) (σ.all τ) := by grind [Sub.refl]
50:       have ⟨_, _, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ := der.tabs_inv sub
51:       have ⟨X, mem⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [Ty.fv, fvTy] Var
52:       simp at mem
53:       have : Γ = (Context.mapVal (·[X := σ']) []) ++ Γ := by grind
54:       rw [openTy_substTy_intro (X := X), open_subst_intro (X := X)] <;> grind [subst_ty]
55:     case tapp => grind
56:   case let' Γ _ _ _ _ L der _ ih₁ _ =>
57:     cases step
58:     case let_bind red₁ _ => apply Typing.let' L (ih₁ red₁); grind
59:     case let_body =>
60:       grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [fvTm] Var, openTm_substTm_intro, subst_tm]
61:   case case Γ _ σ τ _ _ _ L _ _ _ ih₁ _ _ =>
62:     have sub : Sub Γ (σ.sum τ) (σ.sum τ) := by grind [Sub.refl]
63:     have : Γ = [] ++ Γ := by rfl
64:     cases step

66:     case case_inl der _ _ =>

71:       grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [fvTm] Var, openTm_substTm_intro, subst_tm]

11: 
12: /-! # λ-calculus
13: 
14: The λ-calculus with polymorphism and subtyping, with a locally nameless representation of syntax.
15: This file defines the typing relation.
16: 
17: ## References
18: 
19: * [A. Chargueraud, *The Locally Nameless Representation*][Chargueraud2012]
20: * See also <https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~plclub/popl08-tutorial/code/>, from which
21:   this is adapted
22: 
23: -/
24: 
25: @[expose] public section
26: 
27: namespace Cslib
28: 
29: variable {Var : Type*} [DecidableEq Var] [HasFresh Var]
30: 
31: namespace LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub
32: 
33: open Term Ty Ty.Wf Env.Wf Fsub.Sub Context List Binding
34: 
35: /-- The typing relation. -/
36: inductive Typing : Env Var → Term Var → Ty Var → Prop
37:   | var : Γ.Wf → Binding.ty σ ∈ Γ.dlookup x → Typing Γ (fvar x) σ
38:   | abs (L : Finset Var) :
39:       (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₁ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) τ) →
40:       Typing Γ (abs σ t₁) (arrow σ τ)
41:   | app : Typing Γ t₁ (arrow σ τ) → Typing Γ t₂ σ → Typing Γ (app t₁ t₂) τ
42:   | tabs (L : Finset Var) :
43:       (∀ X ∉ L, Typing (⟨X, Binding.sub σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₁ ^ᵗᵞ fvar X) (τ ^ᵞ fvar X)) →
44:       Typing Γ (tabs σ t₁) (all σ τ)
45:   | tapp : Typing Γ t₁ (all σ τ) → Sub Γ σ' σ → Typing Γ (tapp t₁ σ') (τ ^ᵞ σ')
46:   | sub : Typing Γ t τ → Sub Γ τ τ' → Typing Γ t τ'
47:   | let' (L : Finset Var) :
48:       Typing Γ t₁ σ →
49:       (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₂ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) τ) →
50:       Typing Γ (let' t₁ t₂) τ
51:   | inl : Typing Γ t₁ σ → τ.Wf Γ → Typing Γ (inl t₁) (sum σ τ)
52:   | inr : Typing Γ t₁ τ → σ.Wf Γ → Typing Γ (inr t₁) (sum σ τ)
53:   | case (L : Finset Var) :
54:       Typing Γ t₁ (sum σ τ) →
55:       (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₂ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) δ) →
56:       (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty τ⟩ :: Γ) (t₃ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) δ) →
57:       Typing Γ (case t₁ t₂ t₃) δ
58: 
59: namespace Typing
60: 
61: variable {Γ Δ Θ : Env Var} {σ τ δ : Ty Var}
62: 
63: attribute [grind .] Typing.var Typing.app Typing.tapp Typing.sub Typing.inl Typing.inr
64: 
65: set_option linter.tacticAnalysis.verifyGrindOnly false in
66: /-- Typings have well-formed contexts and types. -/
67: @[grind →]
68: lemma wf {Γ : Env Var} {t : Term Var} {τ : Ty Var} (der : Typing Γ t τ) : Γ.Wf ∧ t.LC ∧ τ.Wf Γ := by
69:   induction der <;> let L := free_union Var <;> have ⟨x, nmem⟩ := fresh_exists L
70:   case tabs ih =>
71:     cases (ih x (by grind)).left
72:     split_ands
73:     · grind
74:     · apply LC.tabs L <;> grind
75:     · apply Ty.Wf.all L <;> grind
76:   case abs ih =>
77:     cases (ih x (by grind)).left
78:     grind [LC.abs L, Wf.strengthen]
79:   case let' => grind [LC.let' L, Ty.Wf.strengthen]
80:   case case => refine ⟨?_, LC.case L ?_ ?_ ?_, ?_⟩ <;> grind [Ty.Wf.strengthen]
81:   case var => grind [of_bind_ty]
82:   case app => grind only [LC.app, cases Ty.Wf]
83:   all_goals grind [open_lc]
84: 
85: /-- Weakening of typings. -/
86: lemma weaken (der : Typing (Γ ++ Δ) t τ) (wf : (Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).Wf) :
87:     Typing (Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ) t τ := by
88:   generalize eq : Γ ++ Δ = ΓΔ at der
89:   induction der generalizing Γ
90:   case' abs => apply abs ((Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom ∪ free_union Var)
91:   case' tabs => apply tabs ((Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom ∪ free_union Var)
92:   case' let' der _ => apply let' ((Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom ∪ free_union Var) (der wf eq)
93:   case' case der _ _ => apply case ((Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom ∪ free_union Var) (der wf eq)
94:   all_goals
95:     grind [Wf.weaken, Sub.weaken, Wf.of_env_ty, Wf.of_env_sub, Sub.refl, <= sublist_dlookup]
96: 
97: /-- Weakening of typings (at the front). -/
98: lemma weaken_head (der : Typing Δ t τ) (wf : (Γ ++ Δ).Wf) :
99:     Typing (Γ ++ Δ) t τ := by
100:   have eq : Δ = [] ++ Δ := by rfl
101:   rw [eq] at der
102:   grind [Typing.weaken der wf]
103: 
104: /-- Narrowing of typings. -/
105: lemma narrow (sub : Sub Δ δ δ') (der : Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) t τ) :
106:     Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ⟩ :: Δ) t τ := by
107:   generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ = Θ at der
108:   induction der generalizing Γ
109:   case var X' _ _ =>
110:     grind [Env.Wf.narrow, List.perm_nodupKeys, => List.perm_dlookup]
111:   case' abs  => apply abs (free_union Var)
112:   case' tabs => apply tabs (free_union Var)
113:   case' let' der _ => apply let' (free_union Var) (der eq)
114:   case' case der _ _ => apply case (free_union Var) (der eq)
115:   all_goals grind [Ty.Wf.narrow, Env.Wf.narrow, Sub.narrow]
116: 
117: /-- Term substitution within a typing. -/
118: lemma subst_tm (der : Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, .ty σ⟩ :: Δ) t τ) (der_sub : Typing Δ s σ) :
119:     Typing (Γ ++ Δ) (t[X := s]) τ := by
120:   generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, .ty σ⟩ :: Δ = Θ at der
121:   induction der generalizing Γ X
122:   case var σ' _ X' _ _ =>
123:     have : Γ ++ ⟨X, .ty σ⟩ :: Δ ~ ⟨X, .ty σ⟩ :: (Γ ++ Δ) := perm_middle
124:     by_cases eq : X = X'
125:     · #adaptation_note
126:       /--
127:       Moving from `nightly-2025-09-15` to `nightly-2025-10-19`,
128:       I've had to remove the `append_assoc` lemma from grind;
129:       without this `grind` is exploding. This requires further investigation.
130:       -/
131:       grind [→ List.mem_dlookup, weaken_head, Env.Wf.strengthen, -append_assoc]
132:     · grind [Env.Wf.strengthen, => List.perm_dlookup]
133:   case abs => grind [abs (free_union Var), openTm_substTm_var]
134:   case tabs => grind [tabs (free_union Var), openTy_substTm_var]
135:   case let' der _ => grind [let' (free_union Var) (der eq), openTm_substTm_var]
136:   case case der _ _ =>
137:     apply case (free_union Var) (der eq) <;> grind [openTm_substTm_var]
138:   all_goals grind [Env.Wf.strengthen, Ty.Wf.strengthen, Sub.strengthen]
139: 
140: /-- Type substitution within a typing. -/
141: lemma subst_ty (der : Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) t τ) (sub : Sub Δ δ δ') :
142:     Typing (Γ.mapVal (·[X := δ]) ++ Δ) (t[X := δ]) (τ[X := δ]) := by
143:   generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ = Θ at der
144:   induction der generalizing Γ X
145:   case var σ _ X' _ mem =>
146:     have := map_subst_nmem Δ X δ
147:     have := @mapVal_mem Var (f := ((·[X := δ]) : Binding Var → Binding Var))
148:     grind [Env.Wf.map_subst, → notMem_keys_of_nodupKeys_cons]
149:   case abs => grind [abs (free_union [Ty.fv] Var), Ty.subst_fresh, openTm_substTy_var]
150:   case tabs => grind [tabs (free_union Var), openTy_substTy_var, open_subst_var]
151:   case let' der _ =>
152:     apply let' (free_union Var) (der eq)
153:     grind [openTm_substTy_var]
154:   case case der _ _ =>
155:     apply case (free_union Var) (der eq) <;> grind [openTm_substTy_var]
156:   case tapp => grind [Ty.open_subst, Env.Wf.map_subst, Ty.Wf.map_subst, Sub.map_subst]
157:   all_goals grind [Env.Wf.map_subst, Ty.Wf.map_subst, Sub.map_subst]
158:

160: 
161: omit [HasFresh Var]

163: /-- Invert the typing of an abstraction. -/
164: lemma abs_inv (der : Typing Γ (.abs γ' t) τ) (sub : Sub Γ τ (arrow γ δ)) :
165:      Sub Γ γ γ'
166:   ∧ ∃ δ' L, ∀ x ∉ (L : Finset Var),
167:     Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty γ'⟩ :: Γ) (t ^ᵗᵗ .fvar x) δ' ∧ Sub Γ δ' δ := by
168:   generalize eq : Term.abs γ' t = e at der
169:   induction der generalizing t γ' γ δ
170:   case abs τ L _ _ =>
171:     cases eq
172:     cases sub
173:     split_ands
174:     · assumption
175:     · exists τ, L
176:       grind
177:   case sub Γ _ τ τ' _ _ ih =>
178:     subst eq
179:     have sub' : Sub Γ τ (γ.arrow δ) := by grind
180:     obtain ⟨_, δ', L, _⟩ := ih sub' (by rfl)
181:     split_ands
182:     · assumption
183:     · exists δ', L
184:   all_goals grind
185: 
186: variable [HasFresh Var] in
187: /-- Invert the typing of a type abstraction. -/
188: lemma tabs_inv (der : Typing Γ (.tabs γ' t) τ) (sub : Sub Γ τ (all γ δ)) :
189:      Sub Γ γ γ'
190:   ∧ ∃ δ' L, ∀ X ∉ (L : Finset Var),
191:      Typing (⟨X, Binding.sub γ⟩ :: Γ) (t ^ᵗᵞ fvar X) (δ' ^ᵞ fvar X)
192:      ∧ Sub (⟨X, Binding.sub γ⟩ :: Γ) (δ' ^ᵞ fvar X) (δ ^ᵞ fvar X) := by
193:   generalize eq : Term.tabs γ' t = e at der
194:   induction der generalizing γ δ t γ'
195:   case tabs σ Γ _ τ L der _ =>
196:     cases sub with | all L' sub =>
197:     split_ands
198:     · grind

33: /-- A type is well-formed when it is locally closed and all free variables appear in a context. -/
